# Derm Audit Journal

> Independent clinical reviews and ingredient breakdowns of top anti-aging collagen renewal creams, neuro-dermal expression line serums, botanical skin brightening correctors, under-eye therapies, and scar reduction recovery formulas.

## Core Navigation
- [Review Portal](/index.html): Comparative landing page for top skincare products. Features ratings, side-by-side details, and dynamic matching tools.
- [Comparison Matrix](/comparison.html): Full side-by-side clinical comparison tables evaluating 5 top-tier clinical solutions (Kollagen Intensiv, Synevra UltraLift, Illuminatural 6i, Eyelasticity, Dermefface FX7) against luxury market alternatives.
- [Skin Quiz](/index.html#skin-quiz): 3-question javascript skin matching tool. Connects specific skin concerns to recommended products.
- [Bio Link Page](/links.html): Branded mobile navigation portal optimized for social media referral traffic.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html): GDPR, CCPA, and FTC regulatory compliance disclosures.

## Clinical Reviews
- [Kollagen Intensiv Review](/kollagen-intensiv-review.html): Deep clinical review of Kollagen Intensiv. Analyzes patented peptide Syn-Coll® (clinically proven to boost collagen synthesis by 354% and reduce wrinkles by 84%).
- [Synevra UltraLift Review](/synevra-ultralift-review.html): Clinical analysis of Synevra UltraLift Swiss-inspired peptide system. Evaluates SYN-AKE® neuromuscular relaxation mechanism and VitaLock™ oral beauty nutrients.
- [Illuminatural 6i Review](/illuminatural-6i-review.html): In-depth clinical analysis of Illuminatural 6i skin lightener. Evaluates six botanical actives (including Alpha-Arbutin and Niacinamide) that block melanin synthesis without toxic bleaching chemicals.
- [Eyelasticity Review](/eyelasticity-review.html): Clinical analysis of Eyelasticity Age-Defying Eye Therapy. Evaluates doctor-formulated peptide complex (Eyeseryl®, Regu®-Age, Syn®-Coll, and Pro-Coll-One+) that drains lymphatic puffiness and lightens periorbital dark circles.
- [Dermefface FX7 Review](/dermefface-fx7-review.html): Clinical review of Dermefface FX7 Scar Reduction Therapy. Explains biological remodeling actives (including 10% Symglucan and 2% Pro-Coll-One+) that boost Type I collagen by 1190% to flatten scars.
